patterns: APPSC asks directive -> Article (Art. 40 village panchayats, Art. 45), 'which is NOT a DPSP' (right to work vs FRs; international trade) and whether 39(b)/(c) texts are in the Constitution.
APPSC A-R on non-justiciability: official key treats 'guideposts for legislation' as explaining non-enforceability - the app had the opposite.
Other PSCs repeatedly test: borrowed from Ireland, welfare state in DPSP, social and economic democracy, 42nd Amendment additions (39A, 43A, 48A), environment in both DPSP and FD.
App leans heavily on long match-the-list and multi-statement items plus 2026 current affairs (UCC bills, VB-G RAM G); APPSC style is shorter single-fact items.
Traps: Art. 45 now = ECCE below 6 (6-14 moved to 21A); 'cheque payable at bank's convenience' = K.T. Shah.
